en.headline: Police arrest man for drink driving after vehicle hits railing in Tuen Mun
en.dek: Officers said the driver failed a breath test after the vehicle struck a two-metre railing on Tin King Road in the early hours, with no injuries reported.
body: Police arrested a 41-year-old man on suspicion of drink driving after a light goods vehicle he was driving struck a roadside railing on Tin King Road in Tuen Mun in the early hours of Monday.

According to police, the vehicle was travelling towards Ming Kum Road when it collided with a railing about two metres long around 12.31am. Officers who arrived at the scene detected the smell of alcohol on the driver, surnamed Lau.
Lau failed a preliminary alcohol breath test and was arrested. Police said he was detained for further investigation. No one was injured in the incident.

zh.headline: 屯門田景路輕型貨車撞欄 41歲男司機涉醉駕被捕
zh.dek: 警方指司機在凌晨未能通過酒精呼氣測試，車輛撞向約兩米長欄杆，事件中無人受傷。
body: 警方在周一凌晨拘捕一名41歲男子，涉嫌酒後駕駛。該名男子駕駛的輕型貨車在屯門田景路撞向路旁欄杆。
警方表示，車輛沿田景路往鳴琴路方向行駛，約凌晨12時31分撞向一段約兩米長的欄杆。到場警員發現姓劉司機身上有酒氣。
劉未能通過初步酒精呼氣測試，被警方拘捕並扣留調查。事件中無人受傷。
